subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary 137 millions. This rate increased a little in 2008 which was 152 millions. Again in 2009 this rate was more on the increase which was 156 millions. The population growth rate increased more in 2010 which was 158 millions. Again in 2011, this rate increased a lot which was 164 millions, and in 2012 the population growth increased 167 millions which are more in comparison with other years as shows in the graph. Now it is seen that the population growth rate of Bangladesh began to increase gradually from 2000 to 2012.
